No character restaging.
PRIMARY EDIT: redraw ONLY the contents of the big rear wall screen so they are genuinely printed on its receding physical glass plane. Screen four corners define one projective homography. Use one flat rectangular two-row diagram and map EVERYTHING together into this quadrilateral. Every horizontal line and type baseline must converge with the panel top/bottom edges toward the SAME vanishing point, not stay viewer-horizontal. Rows nearer the top slope more downward toward viewer-right; lower row slopes less, following the real plane. Both rails, label baselines, numbers, divider if any, and circular markers share that projective transform. Round markers become correct perspective ellipses on the glass. Do not change the panel frame or room camera.
Grounded content: keep the TWO probability rails, now label them as the FIRST ROW OF THE TWO SUPPLIED TEST CASES. Compact header exactly "Supplied cases: first row". Upper row short label "Logit +3" and a rail from0 to1. Hollow prediction marker at0.953, filled label marker at1. Lower row short label "Logit -3" and rail from0 to1. Hollow prediction marker at0.047, filled label marker at1. Common small legend exactly "Open: sigmoid(logit)   Filled: label 1". Small status "Losses: pending". Labels0and1 at each rail endpoints, no computed loss values or completion ticks. Keep diagram comfortably within screen away from character head occlusion. Accurate common scale: open upper dot very near filled right dot, open lower dot very near left endpoint; filled dots both at right endpoint. Values .953/.047 do not need extra printed labels. This comes directly from the supplied confident-correct/wrong BCE test first row, not an invented mission measurement. All type legible, short, naturally spaced, no textwall.
Dim the previously decorative secondary screen waveforms to inactive charcoal glass, no replacement invented data. Keep overall original room/skin lighting, architecture and brass. Restrain big screen ink and its border to muted sage, no neon bloom, do not introduce yellow wash. Preserve clean cel-shaded style and original1536x1024 composition. No extra props, figures or geometric overlays outside physical screens.
